title: Blue Angel with Ellis Larkins and Bill Coleman leaving for France
summary: Hall works at the Blue Angel, jobs turn lean, and Coleman leaves for France.

blocks.x: All right, so, at the same time you were working this radio thing, you were also working with Ellis at the Blue Angel?

Yeah. We had been working at the Blue Angel and then we got let out of the Blue Angel and we were doing other gigs for the William Morris office. But the jobs were lean at the time so we weren't working together that much and then Bill went with Sy Oliver's big band.
Bill Coleman. Before he was commissioned to go to France by the French government.
When was that? When did he go to France?
Yeah, here it says, "CBS staff (inaudible) Paul Baron, '43 and '44.
Yeah. Now, other than the times you would go to Chicago, you were in New York continually in this period.
Well, I worked the theater continuous. for ten years.
That was right after Ellis Larkin?
